text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Tenno Sho! Spring! Hark, with what majesty these words toll!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This race I have long striven for is the first spectacular event of my senior year. What could be more fitting?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it carries a lot of influence.
Yeah, it carries a lot of influence.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Influence… Yes, the one thing I do not have at the moment.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I lack influence. Even with my abilities, overlordly as they are, there remain those reluctant to serve.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thus, I shall establish my brand and acquire great influence through a fine victory in this legendary race.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Once achieved, even the most stubborn of the old order believers will have no choice but to admit that I am their new lord.
choice_data_list: You've got a lot on your plate, huh?
You've got a lot on your plate, huh?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes, but that is what makes being the Overlord so divine.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: After this spring Tenno Sho, the heroes of the previous generation, as well as Doto, will be awaiting my challenge.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But today, I have only one rival—that unseen foe by the name of "influence"!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I, the soon-to-be Centurial Overlord, will not falter.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Observe, as I take the hand of those stubborn old fools in a marvelous ensemble performance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With dignified steps, T.M. Opera O struts away toward the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This distinguished race will test whether she is a true ruler or not.
